[package_boundaries]
version = 2
status = "draft"
contract_role = "ownership_and_narrowing_register"
description = """
Canonical per-package ownership and dependency-narrowing register. Root-level
directions are enforced by architecture/imports/policy.toml. This register is
read fail-closed by tools/quality/lint/lint_imports.py and by
tools/quality/validation/check_package_import_gates.py through
tools/quality/validation/architecture_report_only_contracts.py. Legacy
packages are marked with `legacy = true` and carry a `migration_target` plus
`frozen = true`: no new code in-bound or out-bound.
"""

# These real direction-matrix roots do not yet have ratified primary package
# contracts. Naming the absence is deliberate; it is not an inferred owner.

[[deliberately_ungoverned_root]]
root = "corpus"
owner_status = "unappointed"
required_owner_role = "Corpus package owner"
reason = "Evaluation-fixture loaders are not runtime authority; no Corpus package owner or primary/public package contract has been appointed."

[[deliberately_ungoverned_root]]
root = "data_requirement"
owner_status = "unappointed"
reason = "The requirement compiler has no ratified primary package contract or aggregate public-facade entry; keep it direction-matrix-only until those are appointed together."

[[deliberately_ungoverned_root]]
root = "legal_requirement"
owner_status = "unappointed"
reason = "The legal-requirement compiler has no ratified primary package contract or aggregate public-facade entry; do not infer an owner from its consumers."

[[deliberately_ungoverned_root]]
root = "pdc"
owner_status = "documented_not_governed"
reason = "Its README names team-policyos-runtime, but no primary package contract or aggregate public-facade mirror is ratified; this coverage repair does not fabricate them."

[[deliberately_ungoverned_root]]
root = "policy_grammar"
owner_status = "unappointed"
reason = "The grammar compiler has no ratified primary package contract or aggregate public-facade entry; keep package governance explicitly pending."

[[deliberately_ungoverned_root]]
root = "schemas"
owner_status = "unappointed"
reason = "The schema-support root has no package README, appointed package owner, or public facade; classification must precede package governance."

[[deliberately_ungoverned_root]]
root = "scholar_requirement"
owner_status = "unappointed"
reason = "The Scholar requirement compiler has no ratified primary package contract or aggregate public-facade entry; keep its package-governance slot explicit and empty."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Active product layers.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

module = "polisyos.common"
owner = "team-core"
public_facade = "polisyos.common"
allowed_dependencies = []
forbidden_dependencies = ["polisyos.*"]

module = "polisyos.ir"
